subject: Shiloh Baptist Church Off-Cycle Application Review
overview: The committee evaluated an off-cycle funding request for accessibility and daycare expansion at Shiloh Baptist Church, ultimately referring the matter to the regular annual funding cycle. Members also reviewed the preliminary list of fiscal year 2025 project applications and updated policies regarding administrative fund expenditures.

items.title: Shiloh Baptist Church Off-Cycle Application Review
items.summary: Declined the request for off-cycle funding for church accessibility improvements and daycare expansion, referring the application to the regular fiscal year 2025 cycle for further deliberation. The committee determined that while the project is a high priority, it did not meet the strict criteria for emergency urgency required to bypass the standard funding schedule.

items.title: Review of FY25 Project Applications
items.summary: Reviewed a preliminary list of applications totaling approximately $2.8 million, including proposals for City Hall ADA bathroom upgrades, Affordable Housing Trust funding, and various historic restorations. Staff noted that the total requests currently exceed the available budget by approximately $800,000.

items.title: Administrative Fund Expenditure Policy
items.summary: Approved a new policy requiring formal committee approval for any administrative expenditures exceeding $5,000. This fund is used for operational costs, subject matter expert consultations, and legal fees associated with preservation restrictions.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Tabling Events
items.summary: Approved the minutes for the meeting of July 9, 2024, and discussed volunteer coordination for upcoming community outreach events. A brief update was provided regarding a conflict with the Thomas Brooks Park project meeting scheduled for October 22.
